name: CC0 Water Lily, Nymphaea cv.
creator: ffish.asia / floraZia.com
educationalRole: A genus-level example of Nymphaea leaves and flower in the Bangladesh flora collection. Do not claim that the source establishes a local species or cultivar identity.
modifications: Welded vertices and simplified with glTF Transform 4.5.1 (target ratio 0.12, error limit 0.003).
Resized textures to a maximum 512 px and encoded supported textures as WebP at quality 78.
Quantized supported geometry attributes with glTF Transform; texture coordinates outside the normalized range were left unchanged.
limitations: The source model is a Nymphaea cultivar, not a verified local Bangladesh শাপলা cultivar.
The model is static and does not include authored animation.
The original 84.2 MB GLB was too large for routine mobile delivery; the optimized 7.9 MB model is about 90% smaller.
